deviations.why: the converter only permutes axes and drops the duplicate vocoder (values bit-exact, spec 02), so this is the reference on the released tensors without a second 1.7 GB download; the torch run is local CPU float32

architecture_notes.note: Real weights: audio VAE decode 12 ms (Smoke) / 16 ms (Baseline); vocoder 0.28 s / 1.44 s; peak 3.4 / 4.75 GiB (scripts/profile_components.py (real Lite-distill weights, bf16, M3 Max, 2026-10-31)).

architecture_notes.topic: anti-aliased activations are the vocoder's cost
architecture_notes.note: Each of the 6 stages runs 18 anti-aliased activations (2x upsample by a 12-tap depthwise transposed conv, SnakeBeta, 12-tap depthwise downsample). At Baseline one activation takes 11-14 ms, about 0.22 s of each stage's 0.23-0.28 s; stage time stays flat because length x channels is constant per stage, i.e. it is memory-bandwidth bound.
architecture_notes.optimization: A fused Metal kernel (mx.fast.metal_kernel) doing upsample -> snake -> downsample in registers would cut the 4 full-size intermediates per activation; the convolutions themselves are a small share.

architecture_notes.note: The mid-block attention is one head over 2048 channels and only 45-218 frames.
